title: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp., a SPAC registered on Nasdaq under ticker ACAAU, filed an 8-K announcing that commencing April 10, 2026, holders of its units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares (ticker ACAA) and warrants (ticker ACAAW) included in the units. The warrants have an exercise price of $11.50 per share.
key_points: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. is a Cayman Islands-incorporated SPAC listed on Nasdaq under symbols ACAAU, ACAA, and ACAAW.
Effective April 10, 2026, unit holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants.
Class A ordinary shares will trade under ticker ACAA; warrants trade under ACAAW on Nasdaq Global Market.
Warrant exercise price is $11.50 per share for one Class A ordinary share.
No fractional warrants will be issued; only whole warrants will trade.
The filing is signed by David Berry, CEO, on April 8, 2026.
